__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source scraping the Patrolli /metrics endpoint.

description: Patrolli internal Prometheus metrics. Rates account for counter resets; range totals use increase(). Select the Prometheus data source during import, then filter by job and instance. Configure the data source scrape interval to match Prometheus. Missing or unused components show No data; cluster forwarding is exported only in cluster mode.

panels.title: Sink records sent / s
panels.description: Successfully sent sink records across the selected targets.

panels.title: Sink records sent · selected range
panels.description: Estimated increase over the dashboard time range, accounting for counter resets.

panels.title: Channel messages dropped · selected range
panels.description: Estimated channel drops over the dashboard time range. Missing series remain No data.

panels.title: Oldest metrics snapshot
panels.description: Maximum age of the latest internal snapshot across selected targets and components.

panels.title: Record throughput by stage
panels.description: Stage counts can differ because records may be filtered, expanded, routed, or forwarded. Do not sum these stages as unique ingestion.

panels.title: Errors by component
panels.description: Separate error counters; they use different units of work and may describe the same event at multiple stages. Sink retries count failed attempts, not lost records. Processor records unrouted are lost with nothing downstream (no matching processor or sink), not errored.

panels.title: Channel messages sent dropped and lost
panels.description: Per-channel message rates.

panels.title: Channel batches sent dropped and lost
panels.description: Per-channel batch rates.

panels.title: Memory channel capacity used
panels.description: Queued batches / configured batch capacity. Zero-capacity and disk channels are omitted.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (job, instance, channel_group, channel) (patrolli_channel_queue_length{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) / ((sum by (job, instance, channel_group, channel) (patrolli_channel_queue_capacity{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) > 0)

panels.title: Disk channel capacity used
panels.description: Disk bytes used / configured disk limit. Zero-limit and memory channels are omitted.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (job, instance, channel_group, channel) (patrolli_channel_disk_usage_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) / ((sum by (job, instance, channel_group, channel) (patrolli_channel_disk_limit_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) > 0)

panels.title: Channel send wait
panels.description: Cumulative wait seconds per second. Concurrent workers can produce values greater than one; this is not a latency percentile.

panels.title: Snapshot age by component
panels.description: Snapshot age is independent of Prometheus scrape success; rising age can indicate stalled internal metric publication.

panels.title: Listener time spent · stacked
panels.description: Rate of cumulative timing counters in seconds per second, summed over workers. Green = engine work; red = time sending output (including downstream waits); blue = waiting for input or the next batch tick. Sustained send wait can indicate downstream backpressure; receive wait usually means input starvation or idle time. All selected components are stacked together; use the legend and tooltip to identify each job, instance and component. Values can exceed 1 s/s and are not CPU utilization or a complete wall-clock budget. Total time is not stacked because it includes the phases. Compare send-wait share and channel capacity/drops to locate bottlenecks.

panels.title: Monitor time spent · stacked
panels.description: Rate of cumulative timing counters in seconds per second, summed over workers. Green = engine work; red = time sending output (including downstream waits); blue = waiting for input or the next batch tick. Sustained send wait can indicate downstream backpressure; receive wait usually means input starvation or idle time. All selected components are stacked together; use the legend and tooltip to identify each job, instance and component. Values can exceed 1 s/s and are not CPU utilization or a complete wall-clock budget. Total time is not stacked because it includes the phases. Compare send-wait share and channel capacity/drops to locate bottlenecks. Monitor engine time includes checks and batch construction; send time is recorded by a separate batch worker.

panels.title: Processor time spent · stacked
panels.description: Rate of cumulative timing counters in seconds per second, summed over workers. Green = engine work; red = time sending output (including downstream waits); blue = waiting for input or the next batch tick. Sustained send wait can indicate downstream backpressure; receive wait usually means input starvation or idle time. All selected components are stacked together; use the legend and tooltip to identify each job, instance and component. Values can exceed 1 s/s and are not CPU utilization or a complete wall-clock budget. Total time is not stacked because it includes the phases. Compare send-wait share and channel capacity/drops to locate bottlenecks.

panels.title: Sink time spent · stacked
panels.description: Rate of cumulative timing counters in seconds per second, summed over workers. Green = engine work; red = time sending output (including downstream waits); blue = waiting for input or the next batch tick. Sustained send wait can indicate downstream backpressure; receive wait usually means input starvation or idle time. All selected components are stacked together; use the legend and tooltip to identify each job, instance and component. Values can exceed 1 s/s and are not CPU utilization or a complete wall-clock budget. Total time is not stacked because it includes the phases. Compare send-wait share and channel capacity/drops to locate bottlenecks. Sink send wait includes destination I/O and flushing.

panels.title: Processor node time spent · stacked
panels.description: Rate of cumulative timing counters in seconds per second, summed over workers. Green = engine work; red = time sending output (including downstream waits); blue = waiting for input or the next batch tick. Sustained send wait can indicate downstream backpressure; receive wait usually means input starvation or idle time. All selected components are stacked together; use the legend and tooltip to identify each job, instance and component. Values can exceed 1 s/s and are not CPU utilization or a complete wall-clock budget. Total time is not stacked because it includes the phases. Compare send-wait share and channel capacity/drops to locate bottlenecks. Processor nodes expose engine and send timing only; there is no receive-wait counter. These timings are also included in the processor totals.

panels.title: Send-wait share by component
panels.description: Send-wait rate / (engine + send-wait + receive-wait rates), calculated separately for each job, instance and component. Processor nodes use engine + send wait because they have no receive-wait counter. A high share identifies components spending most recorded time sending downstream; compare channel capacity, drops and throughput to confirm backpressure. Sink send time includes destination I/O and flushing. This is a share of instrumented time, not CPU utilization or worker capacity. A zero timing denominator is omitted. Processor node and processor series overlap in scope and are not stacked.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (job, instance, listener_id, listener_name) (rate(patrolli_listener_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (((sum by (job, instance, listener_id, listener_name) (rate(patrolli_listener_engine_time_spent_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance, listener_id, listener_name) (rate(patrolli_listener_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance, listener_id, listener_name) (rate(patrolli_listener_receive_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) > 0)

100 * (sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_monitor_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (((sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_monitor_engine_time_spent_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_monitor_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_monitor_receive_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) > 0)

100 * (sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_processor_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (((sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_processor_engine_time_spent_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_processor_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance) (rate(patrolli_processor_receive_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) > 0)

100 * (sum by (job, instance, sink_id, sink_name) (rate(patrolli_sink_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (((sum by (job, instance, sink_id, sink_name) (rate(patrolli_sink_engine_time_spent_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance, sink_id, sink_name) (rate(patrolli_sink_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance, sink_id, sink_name) (rate(patrolli_sink_receive_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) > 0)

100 * (sum by (job, instance, node_id) (rate(patrolli_processor_node_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (((sum by (job, instance, node_id) (rate(patrolli_processor_node_engine_time_spent_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) + (sum by (job, instance, node_id) (rate(patrolli_processor_node_send_wait_time_seconds_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) > 0)

panels.title: Listener item outcomes
panels.description: Listener item counters by listener and target.

panels.title: Listener byte outcomes
panels.description: Bytes received and processed by each listener.

panels.title: Listener record delivery
panels.description: Record delivery counters may overlap and should be interpreted separately.

panels.title: Monitor item outcomes
panels.description: Monitor item counters across polling work.

panels.title: Processor record outcomes
panels.description: Processor-wide rates. Unrouted: dropped because nothing was downstream (a processor id no longer configured, no processor id and no input-less sink, or a processor with no next step). Counted per drop, so output fanned out to two dead ends counts twice, as Sent counts once per sink.

panels.title: Sink record outcomes
panels.description: Sink rates by target and sink identity.

panels.title: Processor node outcomes
panels.description: Per-node rates; the same record can pass through multiple nodes.

panels.title: Processor edge throughput
panels.description: Records sent across each processor edge.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, source_id, target_id, target_kind) (rate(patrolli_processor_edge_records_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Engine work
panels.description: Engine seconds per second, summed over workers. Values can exceed one; this is neither CPU utilization nor per-record latency.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Current worker counts.

panels.title: Sink records retried
panels.description: Records sent again after a failed attempt, counted once per attempt: a batch that needs three attempts counts twice. Errored records are the ones a sink dropped: failed to encode, rejected by the destination, or out of retries (retry.max_elapsed).

panels.title: Sink records pending retry
panels.description: Records the sink workers hold for their next attempt. A value that stays above zero means the destination keeps failing and the sink's input topic is backing up behind it.

panels.title: Sink endpoint health
panels.description: ClickHouse and OTAP sinks only, one row per destination endpoint. Up takes sends; Backing off means the sink is holding off that endpoint after a failed send.

targets.expr: min by (job, instance, sink_id, sink_name, endpoint) (patrolli_sink_endpoint_up{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

panels.title: Lookup outcomes
panels.description: Per-processor series appear after the processor first uses the table.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_lookups_hit_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_lookups_missed_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_lookups_errored_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Lookup hit ratio
panels.description: Hits / all lookups, including misses and key errors. Idle series have no ratio.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_lookups_hit_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) / ((sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_lookups_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.title: Mutable table write outcomes
panels.description: Mutable table writes and removals by processor.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_writes_inserted_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_writes_updated_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_writes_rejected_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_writes_errored_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, node_id) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_processor_removes_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Lookup table rows
panels.description: Current rows and mutable table caps. Immutable tables do not export a row cap.

panels.title: Lookup table loads and failures
panels.description: Immutable table load rates. A failed load can leave an older generation available.

panels.title: Lookup source rows skipped
panels.description: Cumulative skipped-row counters by rejection reason, across all loads. Uses counters rather than current-generation gauges.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, table_id, table_name, reason) (rate(patrolli_lookup_table_rows_skipped_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mutable table rejections and expiration
panels.description: Lifecycle counters for mutable tables. Released strings are pool entries, not rows.

panels.title: Latest lookup load failed
panels.description: Immutable tables only. 1 means the most recent attempt failed; 0 means it did not.

panels.title: Forwarder record outcomes
panels.description: Exported only in cluster mode.

panels.title: Forwarder peer record outcomes
panels.description: Record rates by forwarder peer. Exported only in cluster mode.

panels.title: Forwarder peer byte outcomes
panels.description: Byte rates by forwarder peer. Exported only in cluster mode.

panels.title: Forwarder peer connections
panels.description: Current live connections; this metric is a gauge.

panels.title: Forwarder server records
panels.description: Incoming cluster forwarding server record counters.

panels.title: Forwarder server bytes
panels.description: Bytes processed by the cluster forwarding server.

title: Patrolli — Internal Metrics
